fdroid:com.awagam.android.name: AWAGAM TLD and Domain Blocker
fdroid:com.awagam.android.summary: Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level using your own blocklists
fdroid:com.awagam.android.description:
AWAGAM blocks access to top-level domains and domains at the DNS level, using blocklists you configure yourself.
It runs a local VPN that intercepts DNS queries. Blocked lookups resolve to 0.0.0.0; everything else is forwarded to the DNS-over-HTTPS resolver of your choice, or to a local resolver like InviZible Pro’s DNSCrypt. Your ordinary Internet traffic is never routed through the VPN.
The app ships with no blocking rules of its own. What gets blocked is entirely up to you.
Features:
* Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level
* DNS-over-HTTPS upstream (DNS4EU, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard), or a local resolver on the device
* Add, edit, and manage as many blocklist URLs as you like
* Compatible with the AWAGAM browser extension blocklist format, including bundles
* Temporarily disable protection (5 minutes, 15 minutes, 1 hour) with automatic restart
* DNS query statistics: queries, blocked requests, cache performance
* Export your configuration to Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, or hosts format
* Background blocklist updates every 6 hours
* Watchdog that restarts filtering if the system stops it
* Auto-start on boot
Privacy:
AWAGAM collects no personal data. All processing happens on your device. There is no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, and no DNS query logging. The only network connections are DNS queries to the upstream resolver you select and blocklist fetches from URLs you configure.
The app opts out of Android backup and device-to-device transfer, so your blocklist subscriptions are never copied into your Google account. Use the export function to move your configuration yourself.
Limitations:
* DNS sees domain names, not full URLs, so URL-level blocking is not possible. Use the browser extension for that.
* Android permits one VPN at a time, so AWAGAM cannot run alongside another VPN app.
* Apps that use their own DNS-over-HTTPS resolver bypass system DNS filtering.

fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.name: AirGuard - AirTag protection
fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.summary: AirGuard detects trackers that are used for stalking and warns you.
fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.description:
With AirGuard, you get the anti-stalking protection you deserve!
The app scans your surroundings in the background to detect trackers like AirTags, Samsung SmartTags, or Google Find My Device trackers. If a tracker is following you, you will receive an instant notification.
These trackers are often no larger than a coin and are unfortunately misused to secretly track people. Since each tracker works differently, you would typically need multiple apps to detect unwanted tracking.
AirGuard combines the detection of various trackers into a single app – keeping you protected with ease.
Once a tracker is detected, you can make it play a sound (for supported models) or perform a manual scan to locate it. If you find a tracker, we recommend disabling it to prevent further tracking of your location.
The app stores location data exclusively on your device, allowing you to review where a tracker has followed you. Your personal data is never shared.
If no trackers are found, the app runs silently in the background and won’t bother you.
 How does the app work? 
AirGuard uses Bluetooth to detect AirTags, Samsung SmartTags, and other trackers. All data is processed and stored locally on your device.
If a tracker is detected in at least three different locations, you will receive a warning. You can adjust the security level in the settings to receive even faster alerts.
 Who are we? 
We are part of the Technical University of Darmstadt. This project is part of the scientific research conducted by the Secure Mobile Networking Lab.
Our goal is to protect people’s privacy and investigate how widespread the issue of tracker-based stalking is.
You can voluntarily participate in an anonymous study to help us gain more insights into the usage and spread of these trackers.
This app will never be monetized – there are no ads and no paid features. You will never be charged for using it.
Our privacy policy can be found here:
https://tpe.seemoo.tu-darmstadt.de/privacy-policy.html
 Legal Notice 
AirTag, Find My, and iOS are registered trademarks of Apple Inc.
This project is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

apple-macos:6808984060.description:
Isai is a music player for people who own their music.
Maybe it lives on MEGA. Maybe on Dropbox, a Nextcloud server, a Synology in the cupboard, or a folder on your phone. Connect it once and Isai reads the tags, builds a proper library with albums, artists and artwork, and streams straight from where the files are. Nothing goes through a server in between, and nothing is transcoded on the way.
WHAT PLAYS
FLAC, ALAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, Ogg Vorbis and Opus. DSF and DFF, including DST. Embedded lyrics and .lrc files scroll along with the song.
DSD goes through Isai's own engine. It goes out as DoP to a DAC that takes it, and is carefully converted to PCM for everything else. Playback is gapless, and you can turn on crossfade. Isai skips it wherever it would change the sound.
THE SIGNAL PATH
Tap the quality badge to see what happened between the file and the output: the source, the decoder, any processing, the device it went to, and a verdict. On the Mac, BIT PERFECT means exactly that. Isai can take exclusive access to your DAC and set its sample rate and word length to match the file. Then it reads those settings back from the hardware to make sure they stuck. If the equalizer is on, the verdict says so. If the audio was resampled, it says that too.
On iPhone and iPad, Isai asks an external DAC for the file's own rate and tells you what the system actually gave it, even when that isn't the answer you wanted.
PURE MUSIC ON IPHONE DUO
On an iPhone Duo, Isai can stop looking like an app and turn into a machine.
Choose a pocket cassette player, a portable CD player or a turntable, each modelled on the classics of the eighties, and the machine fills the screen. No tabs, no status bar. Fold the phone shut and the cover screen is the player in your hand, with the tape turning behind its little window or the disc spinning under the lid. Open it and your records sit on one page with the open machine on the other.
Underneath, it's the same library and the same signal path.
ONE LIBRARY, EVERY DEVICE
Add a source on your iPhone and it shows up on your Mac, your iPad and your Apple TV, already signed in. Favourites, playlists, play history and where you stopped in a track all sync through iCloud. So does the library itself: scan a source once and your other devices get the albums without reading the files again. Downloads keep the original files, run in the background, and wait for Wi-Fi if you ask them to.
PLAY ON
Two copies of Isai on the same Wi-Fi can control each other. Sit on the sofa with your phone and play through the Mac that's wired to the good DAC. The queue, the position and the Signal Path follow whichever device is making the sound. Nothing leaves your network and there's no account to create. Your own devices recognise each other through your Apple Account. Anything else has to be let in by hand, with a code shown on both screens.
ALSO
A ten-band equalizer with presets you can copy and rename. An A/B loop for the sixteen bars you're learning, or the cymbal decay you're judging a cable on, with saved loops that play one after another. Album editions, so the FLAC, the MP3 rip and the Apple Music copy of one record show up as a single album with the format shown once. Animated covers when a label ships them. And if you subscribe to Apple Music, it sits on the same shelf as the files you own.
ISAI PRO
Free for the music on your device and for Apple Music. Pro adds cloud sources (MEGA, Dropbox, WebDAV), Play On, Pure Music on iPhone Duo and the widgets. Monthly or Yearly, each with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or Lifetime: one payment that never renews. Bought Pro before? It's Lifetime and stays unlocked for good.

flathub:app.drey.Haystack.name: Haystack
flathub:app.drey.Haystack.description:
Haystack is a small GNOME application for editing OpenQA needles. A
 needle is a screenshot on which areas have been marked that must match
 with the output of a system under test in OpenQA.
 The application works on a local needles repository. You open the
 repository folder, select a needle to edit, and start drawing. You can
 also change the screenshot, either from a local file, or copy-pasting one
 from elsewhere (for example a failed test in OpenQA).
 For any feedback, questions or general issues, please file an issue on
 the GitLab page.

flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.name: Time Cop
flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.summary: A time tracking app that respects your privacy and gets the job done without getting too fancy
flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.description:
A time tracking app that respects your privacy and gets the job done without getting too fancy.
 Features:
 Offline-only, mobile-centric design
 Runs on Linux, iOS, and Android
 Fully private—there is no tracking / spying / advertising / etc
 Keep track of tasks with multiple parallel timers that can be started with the tap of a button
 Associate timers with projects to group your work (or don't)
 Start, stop, edit, and delete timers whenever with no fuss
 Export data as a .csv file, filtered by timespans and projects
 Export the app's database for full access to all of its data
 Automatic light mode / dark mode based on your device settings
 Localized in several languages (thanks to Google Translate): English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
 Open source (licensed under Apache-2.0)—fork away (https://github.com/hamaluik/timecop)

flathub:com.plexamp.Plexamp.name: Plexamp
flathub:com.plexamp.Plexamp.description:
Plexamp is the answer to the question "what would happen if you gave a handful of Plex music
 and pixel nerds a few cocktails and free rein to create the app of their dreams?"
 Plexamp is a beautiful, dedicated Plex music player with tons of goodies for audiophile purists,
 music curators, and music fans of all ages looking for their next aural fix.
 SUPER AUDIO PLAYER: Loudness leveling, true gapless playback, Sweet Fades™, soft transitions,
 a configurable preamp, a 10-band EQ, and more. Perfection for golden ears, buttery smooth touches
 for the rest of us. Custom pre-caching so your music keeps playing, because sometimes life brings
 you through tunnels.
 MUSIC TO YOUR EYES: Experience your music collection like you've never seen it before, with
 our UltraBlur backgrounds, over a dozen hypnotic visualizers, and four visual themes to satisfy
 every taste.
 FIND YOUR FIX: Radios built from your library and your cooler friends' collections. Travel through
 time, pick a style or mood, or listen album-by-album like the purist you are. Use the Mix Builder
 to explore and craft your perfect blend. Explore your personal charts and see what you were into
 last Fall or your top albums from the 60s.
 OFFLINE BLISS: Grab a few hours of your favorite playlist or stations with just a few taps.
 Download a custom mix or artist radio for the plane. Simple but powerful offline support for when
 you're in the woods or run out of cellular data.
 IT'S THE LITTLE THINGS: Powerful search. Playback activity history. Swipe-up play queue peeking.
 Fun artist explorations. As many settings and tweaks as our resident UXpert let us add.
 ENTERPRISE CLASS CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT: Just kidding. It's a music player.

flathub:org.kde.ktouch.name: KTouch
flathub:org.kde.ktouch.description:
KTouch is a typewriter trainer for learning to touch type. It provides you with text to train
 on and adjusts to different levels depending on how good you are. It displays your keyboard and
 indicates which key to press next and which is the correct finger to use. You learn typing with
 all fingers, step by step, without having to look down at the keyboard to find your keys. It is
 convenient for all ages and the perfect typing tutor for schools, universities, and personal use.
 KTouch ships with dozens of different courses in many languages and a comfortable course editor.
 Different keyboard layouts are supported and new user-defined layouts can be created. During training,
 KTouch collects comprehensive statistical information to help you or your teacher to analyze your
 progress.

EVERYDAY CONTROLS

FOR POWER USERS

 EasyPrivacy, Peter Lowe's list and more
PERMISSIONS, EXPLAINED

firefox-addons:2920948.description:
HoverTranslate – a YouTube subtitle translator for learning languages from videos
Watching a video with Spanish or Japanese subtitles and hit a word you don't know? Just hover over it, and the translation appears right above the subtitles. The video pauses while you read and plays on as soon as you move the pointer away. No copying words into a translator, no losing the thread – you keep watching and understand more.
What HoverTranslate does:
• Translates single words and whole phrases. Found an idiom or a set expression? Hold Shift and sweep the pointer across the words. If you'd rather not hold Shift, you can switch that on in the settings.
• Builds your personal word list. Click a word, and it's saved together with its translation. Export the list as CSV or JSON to review your new words later.
• Works with auto-generated subtitles too – the ones YouTube creates itself – so videos without subtitles from the creator work as well.
• Not just on YouTube itself: when a video is embedded in a blog post, an online course or a news article, just hover over a word the same way.
• Handles Chinese, Japanese and Thai: even though they're written without spaces between words, you get the translation of one word, not the whole line.
• Translates into more than 240 languages and detects the subtitle language on its own.
• Blends in: the translation looks just like your YouTube subtitles. Want something different? Pick your own font, color and size.
• Fits the way you watch: auto-pause can be turned off, and a click can copy the word or its translation instead of saving it.
Translation that understands context
Choose Google, Bing or DeepL. With DeepL (you'll need your own free API key), each word is translated in the context of its whole subtitle line, so a word with several meanings gets the one it has there: "bank" in "we sat on the bank of the river" is a riverbank, not a bank. Your key is stored only on your device.
Free, with no sign-up
HoverTranslate is completely free: no accounts, no subscriptions, no ads. It's open source – the code is on GitHub.
Questions and suggestions: hovertranslate@gmail.com 
Source code: https://github.com/kozii-d/hover-translate 
Changelog: https://github.com/kozii-d/hover-translate/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md 
Install HoverTranslate, open any video with subtitles and hover over the first word you don't know. Enjoy watching!

firefox-addons:523060.name: Trusted Shops extension
firefox-addons:523060.description:
The Trusted Shops browser extension
• is free of charge and installed with one click
• shows shops with the trustmark and money-back guarantee in the search results
• warns you before entering a fake shop
The official Trusted Shops Google Chrome extension shows you which online shops have the Trusted Shops trustmark directly in the search results. These shops offer you the comprehensive money-back guarantee no matter which payment option you've chosen.
In addition, you are actively warned with a pop-up when you enter a shop that Trusted Shops has classified as fraudulent.

firefox-addons:2803212.name: Shopping Cart Share
firefox-addons:2803212.summary: Shopping Cart Share extension lets you compile carts from different stores like Amazon, Bestbuy, and more into one simple cart. With a click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it for later use.
firefox-addons:2803212.description:
Shopping Cart Share is the go-to tool for easy online shopping. Our extension lets you compile carts from different stores like Amazon, Bestbuy, Walmart, and more into one simple cart. With just one click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it for another time. 
Our extension sets a new standard in sharing shopping carts by supporting a broad range of online retailers. Shopping Cart Share is compatible with major sites including Amazon (and all international Amazon stores), Walmart, Bestbuy, Target, Staples and countless other online stores.
For a comprehensive list of supported retailers, visit our website: https://shoppingcartshare.com/supported 
Key features:
- Create a single, unified cart across multiple retailers.
- Share your unified cart or individual carts using a unique cart ID.
- Import shared carts from various retailers.
- Save multi-store cart for later.
- Easy manage carts and print as needed. 
Shopping Cart Share doesn't execute any purchasing actions for you. Our platform merely streamlines the transfer of items from the originator's shopping basket to that of the recipient's - the ultimate transaction process must be undertaken by the user themselves. Please note, Shopping Cart Share operates as an autonomous entity, with no official endorsements or authorizations from any of the retailers mentioned.
Start shopping smarter and sharing easier today with Shopping Cart Share!

firefox-addons:1472219.name: Tracking Time | Time Tracker Button
firefox-addons:1472219.summary: Time tracker for Linear, Planner, Basecamp, Asana and 60+ web tools. Hours flow into timesheets, approvals and client reports.
firefox-addons:1472219.description:
The time tracker that works where the work happens. The TrackingTime extension adds a start/stop timer inside the web tools your team already uses, so hours are logged in context instead of rebuilt at the end of the week.
TrackingTime is time tracking software that runs as the operational back office for agencies and professional services. Every entry you start from the browser lands in the same workspace that runs timesheets, approvals, retainers, invoicing and client reports.
 HOW IT WORKS 
• Install the extension and sign in to your TrackingTime account.
• Open a supported tool and click the timer next to the task, card or ticket.
• The extension detects the task and project and syncs them to TrackingTime. No setup per integration.
 WORKS INSIDE 60+ WEB TOOLS 
• Project management: Asana, Trello, ClickUp, Monday, Wrike, Basecamp, Teamwork, Todoist, Notion, Airtable
• Developer tools: Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Linear
• Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Tasks, Keep
• Microsoft 365 on the web: Outlook.com , Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams
• Support and design: Zendesk, Freshdesk, Figma
 WHAT HAPPENS TO THE HOURS 
• One timesheet per person, ready for review and approval
• Billable hours, rates and invoices on the Pro Plan
• Retainers with pace tracking and burn alerts on the Pro Plan
• Shared, scheduled client reports from the Starter Plan
 NO SURVEILLANCE 
No screenshots, no keystroke logging, no GPS. People decide what becomes a time entry.
 FREE TO START 
The Free Plan supports unlimited users, projects and clients. The extension works on every plan. It works on the web versions of supported tools, not their desktop apps.

firefox-addons:2747362.name: SecureSafe Password Manager
firefox-addons:2747362.summary: Use the SecureSafe password manager to keep track of your ever-growing list of passwords.
firefox-addons:2747362.description:
Password management directly from your browser 
 With the SecureSafe Browser Extension, you can log into websites, online stores or web applications directly from your browser.
 How do I log in to the SecureSafe Password Manager from my browser? 
Open the SecureSafe password manager by clicking on the SecureSafe icon in the top right-hand corner of the browser bar. Now log in with your SecureSafe username and password. If you do not yet have a SecureSafe account, you can register for free via our web or mobile app.
 How can I automatically insert passwords in the login field? 
Search for the password entry using the search field. Select the desired password entry with the mouse and click on the "Fill in" button to automatically populate the login fields.

firefox-addons:477204.description:
This addon shows you your password in two ways:
 With a button: shows the password you wrote only when you click the button (Added the preference to leave the password shown on click.
 Always: shows you the password you wrote always (even while you are typing).
 When the password gets focus: shows you the password when the password gets the focus.

firefox-addons:3110230.name: Tab
firefox-addons:3110230.summary: Save tabs into collections, search your saved links, and pick up where you left off from your new tab.
firefox-addons:3110230.description:
Save tabs into collections, find saved links, and reopen them from your new-tab page.
Keep separate private or shared workspaces. Search your saved archive, save selected tabs while keeping them open, or save a window or native tab group and close eligible tabs after the save is confirmed. Pinned tabs are excluded unless you explicitly include them. Failed uploads keep your tabs open and retain a local recovery operation for retry.
A free Tab account with Google sign-in is required. Your chosen links and collection information are stored by the Tab service at tab.slpixe.com . Tab does not sell your data or use saved links for advertising or AI tagging.
Firefox 140 or newer is required. Desktop only.

apple-macos:6742322421.description:
GO AI Chat – Every Top AI Model, Plus a Full Creative Studio
Chat with GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi and DeepSeek in one app — then turn any idea into images and video without leaving the conversation. Type it, speak it, put every model head to head, or call in a panel of AI experts.
CHAT WITH EVERY TOP MODEL
• Switch between the world's leading AI models and see which suits you.
• Answers stream in live — stop, copy, share or have any reply read aloud.
• Attach up to five photos or shoot one on the spot; dictate instead of typing.
• Ask for a picture mid-chat and generate it right there in the thread.
• Leave the app while it thinks — answers finish in the background and wait for you.
• Export a whole conversation as a formatted PDF.
• Search your history, and sign in with Apple or Google to sync every chat across your devices.
TALK, DON'T TYPE
Voice Chat is a real, hands-free conversation. Just speak and it answers out loud in one of four voices — and you can interrupt it mid-sentence, like you would a friend. Every word is transcribed and saved as a normal chat.
ONE QUESTION, EVERY ANSWER
Multi-Model Chat sends your question to every model at once and lays the answers out side by side, then writes an instant summary of where they agree and where they disagree.
A PANEL OF EXPERTS
Experts Group puts 2–3 AI experts in one room. They answer in turn, build on each other and respectfully disagree. Pick your panel yourself, or let AI assemble the right one for your question.
AI EXPERTS, ON CALL
Doctor, Lawyer, Therapist, Nutrition Coach, Fitness Coach, Finance Advisor, Chef, Tutor, Travel Planner, Tech Support, Car Mechanic, Handyman, Gardener, Fashion Stylist, Dating Coach, Pet Behaviorist, Game Master, Actor, Scientist, Spiritual Guide, AI Specialist — and more arriving all the time. Each has its own expertise and starter prompts. Missing one? Request it.
IMAGE CREATOR & TRANSFORMER
• 40+ creative styles — Photoreal, Cinematic, Anime, Oil Painting, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Ukiyo-e, Art Deco, Synthwave and more.
• 40+ one-tap edits — remove backgrounds and objects, erase watermarks, restore and colorize old photos, upscale, replace skies, retouch skin, make studio headshots and passport photos.
• Brush over any part of a photo and change only that area.
• Aspect ratios sized for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, plus three quality tiers up to 2560px.
VIDEO GENERATOR & STUDIO
• Turn text into video, or bring any still photo to life.
• 4, 8 or 12 second clips, ratios for every platform, up to crisp 1080p.
• Edit existing video with a prompt — no timeline, no editing skills.
COLOR ADJUST — PRO GRADING, NO PRO SOFTWARE
• 40+ cinematic looks: Teal & Orange, Bleach Bypass, Cross Process, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Anamorphic, Noir, Neon and more.
• Or grade it yourself with 23 professional controls across Light, Color, Detail, Effects and Color Grading.
• Everything renders instantly as you drag; press and hold to compare with the original.
• Works on photos and video alike.
SUMMARISER
Drop in a YouTube link, a video, a PDF or an e-book, get the gist in seconds, then ask follow-up questions.
PROMPT LIBRARY
400+ ready-made prompts for images, video and color, searchable by category — and room to save your own.
YOUR GALLERY
Every image and video you make is saved automatically, filterable by type and date, ready to share, save to Photos, or send back into the Studio.
BUILT FOR iOS
Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight search, home-screen quick actions and Handoff between iPhone, iPad and Mac. Available in 40+ languages.
Download GO AI Chat and see what happens when every top AI model — and a full creative studio — fits in one app.
DISCLAIMER: This app offers in-app subscriptions that unlock premium features and enhanced functionality. Some content and advanced AI capabilities require a paid subscription.
